title: TRANSFERRING PATIENT
knowledge: Identify purpose and importance of knowing proper coordination of transfer.
Discusses the importance of handover process during transfer.
skills: Verify physicians order for patient transfer.

Identifies the type of patient transfer:
    a. Room to room transfer
    b. Department to department
    c. Transfer to other Hospital
Coordinates with the unit where the patient will be transferred.
Transfer patient in the Oasis Program (to synchronized all other department e.g. pharmacy and dietary).
Informs and prepares the patient for the said transfer including the file, medicines and belongings to the patient.
Keeps a copy of referral letter to the patient file.
Escorts and endorsed properly the patient to the receiving unit.
Handover documents must be properly filled up.
attitude: Accept constrictive criticism as learning opportunity.
To be self-aware of limitation in knowledge and skills.
Attentive to overall patient experience e.g. pain, anxiety and have ability to provide comfort and emotional support as needed.

Ability to organize and facilitate a Reflection session in and on practice after the Standards in Transferring Patient learning opportunity occurs and activates findings to improve future practice and response.
